payload.text: SAFETY — pre-trade limit breach is hard-classified at the cap, not approximated: LimitSpec::classify maps a projected exposure to a RagStatus by exact threshold order — ratio > 1.0 (exposure strictly over cap) is RagStatus::Breach; ratio >= red is Red; ratio >= amber is Amber; else Green. Breach is the ONLY band above the cap, so a hard limit can never be silently under-classified as a mere Red warning. classify is the single pure breach-decision atom (it reads &self spec + the f64 exposure and returns a Utilization, mutating nothing); pre_trade_check builds on it and turns any is_hard_breach into PreTradeDecision::Reject. The strict-greater-than at the cap means an exposure exactly AT the cap (ratio == 1.0) is Red, not Breach — utilisation up to and including the cap is permitted, beyond it is rejected.
